title: Depth-3 two-stage switching bound
statement:
Let $n \ge 1$, and let $f : \{0,1\}^n \to \{0,1\}$ be the conjunction of $s_2$ DNF formulas $g_1, \dots, g_{s_2}$ on $n$ variables, so that $f(x) = \mathrm{true}$ exactly when $g_i(x) = \mathrm{true}$ for every $i$. Suppose each $g_i$ has width at most $w$, where $w \ge 1$, and that within every term of every $g_i$ no literal is repeated and no two distinct literals share the same variable. Fix natural numbers $l \ge 1$ and $t$, together with real parameters $p_1, p_2 \in (0,1]$ satisfying $p_1 \le 1/(40w)$ and $p_2 \le 1/(40l)$. Writing $D(g)$ for the decision-tree depth of a Boolean function $g$ and $f\restriction_\rho$ for the restricted function $x \mapsto f(\rho\text{-extension of }x)$, a Bernoulli$(p_1 p_2)$ random restriction $\rho$ then satisfies
\[
  \Pr_{\rho}\!\big[\, D(f\restriction_\rho) > t \,\big]
  \;\le\;
  s_2\Big( \big(\tfrac12\big)^{l} + \exp\!\big(-\tfrac{n p_1}{3}\big) \Big)
  \;+\;
  \Big( \big(\tfrac12\big)^{t} + \exp\!\big(-\tfrac{n p_2}{3}\big) \Big).
\]
hypotheses_covered: f is the AND of the s_2 DNF gates g_i
each gate has width at most w
within each term, literals on the same variable are equal (non-degeneracy)
each term has no duplicate literals
random restriction is Bernoulli with parameter p_1 p_2
threshold t on the decision-tree depth of the restricted function
replaced:
Let $f$ be the AND of $s_2$ DNF gates each of width $\le w$ (with $w,l > 0$,
non-degenerate and duplicate-free terms, $n > 0$). For $0 < p_1 \le 1/(40w)$ and
$0 < p_2 \le 1/(40l)$, the composed Bernoulli$(p_1 p_2)$ restriction satisfies
\[
\Pr_\rho[\mathrm{dtDepth}(\mathrm{restrictFn}\, f\,\rho) > t]
\le s_2\bigl((1/2)^l + \exp(-np_1/3)\bigr) + \bigl((1/2)^t + \exp(-np_2/3)\bigr).
\]
